Remaining provenance gap, not a text-accuracy issue: this bundle carries no calibration_attestation.json/DOF ledger of its own (audit E8) - the DOF ledger committed to date covers the base run's bundle (miso_42_coal_econ_srmc), not this ablation-twin bundle (miso_42_coal_econ_srmc-ablation) that now serves as keeper - flagged for the owner, not silently fixed here.
